t: Debarim haasurim beshabbat mishshum hashmaat qol
s: Debarim haasurim beshabbat mishshum hashmaat qol ubo t' seipim: asur lehashmia qol shel shir ella bepeh bilbad, abal lo bedabar acher, gezera shemma yetaqqen kele shir. Veezehu qol shel shir? Kol shemmitkavven lehashmio binimut qetzat kederek shir, kegon mah shennotenim mayim bikli male neqabim umattip al keli matteket kapuy tip tip achar tip tip, kede sheyyishshama qol naim bishbil hacholeh sheyyishan, sheqqol naim mardimo — asur laasot ken ella lecholeh bilbad, abal lo lebari, mippene shehu keen qol shel kele shir, veyesh ligzor shemma yetaqqen kele shir. Abal im mattip bechozeq kede sheyyiqatz hayyashen — muttar ap lebari, sheeno keen qol shel kele shir, kevan sheeno binima ubenachat. Veken lehaqqish al haddelet kede sheyyiptechu lo, veken kol kayyotze bazeh miqqol sheeno derek shir — muttar lehashmio. Veyesh omerim sheap al pi ken asur lehashmio bikli hammeyuchad lekak, gezera shemma yetaqqeno, kegon lehaqqish al haddelet betabbaat haqqebua bah, ap sheeno mekavven leqol shel shir. Velaken asur lashshammash lehakkot al haddelet liqro lebet hakkeneset al yede keli hammeyuchad lekak, ella makkeh beyado al haddelet. Veken nohagin. Veyesh meqomot nohagin shemmakkeh beshabbat bikli acher sheeno meyuchad lekak. Umikkol maqom, en issur bezeh ella keshetztzarik leqol zeh vehu mitkavven lehashmio bikli hammeyuchad lekak ella sheeno mekavven leqol shel shir, abal im eno mitkavven lehashmia qol kelal beoto keli mippene sheeno tzarik lo kelal, ella shehaqqol nishma meelayv keshennotel hakkeli, kegon zug sheyyesh bo inbal vetabbaat sheyyesh bah operet mashmia qol — muttar littelan ulehannichan ap shemmashmiim qol al yede zeh. Vaapillu lelek labush babbeged sheqqabua bo zug hammashmia qol shel shir — muttar, kevan sheeno mitkavven lekak. Umittaam zeh muttar litlot beshabbat al happaroket retzua shebbah teluyim paamonim kede lehashmia qol leanshe bet hakkeneset beshaa shemmotziim hasseper tora kede sheyyishmeu veyaqumu, sheap shezzeh hattoleh happaamonim mitkavven sheyyashmiu qol bishat petichat haaron, mikkol maqom oto happoteach haaron eno mitkavven kelal kede lehashmia qol, veap im haya mitkavven lekak — en leesor, kevan shehu tzorek mitzva, sheyyishmeu haam veyaqumu, vahare apillu letzorek choleh sheyyishan hittiru lehashmia apillu qol shel shir, vekol shekken letzorek mitzva veeno qol shel shir, shehare eno binima ubenachat, ella shehu bikli hammeyuchad lekak bilbad:

Vekol zeh bemashmia qol al yede maaseh, abal bepiv muttar lehashmia qol shel shir, apillu eno kederek shira bepeh, ella keqol keli zemer, o keqol tzippor, kegon ellu sheqqorin lechabrehem umetzaptzepin ketzippor, ap al pi shebbeoto hatztziptzup regilin lehanim beshir — muttar laasoto beshabbat, lepi sheen ligzor shemma yetaqqen kele shir ella bemashmia qol al yede ezeh maaseh, abal lo al yede piv:

Yesh mattirin lomar lenokri lenaggen bikle shir bechuppot mishshum kebod chatan vekalla, lepi shehu tzorek mitzva, shezzehu iqqar simchat chatan vekalla, ubimqom mitzva lo gazeru al amira lenokri bedabar sheeno asur leyisrael ella middibre soperim, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"z. Abal im nipseqa nima bekinnor — asur lomar lo sheyyetaqqenenna, shettiqqun keli hu issur shel tora, veasur lomar lenokri apillu bimqom mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"v (ayyen sham sheen limchot beyad hammeqillim). Veshello bimqom simchat chatan vekalla — asur apillu lomar lo lenaggen bikle shir. Veakshav nahagu lehaqel bezeh. Veen limchot beyadam, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman shl"t:

Zug hamqashqesh leshaot asuy al yede mishqolet — asur leorko beshabbat, mishshum shemmashmia qol shel shir (veod shehu keli hammeyuchad lekak) vehu tzarik leqol zeh umitkavven lo. Abal mibbeod yom muttar leorko velahakino kede sheyyelek viqashqesh kol hashshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"b:

Hamshammer perotayv uzeraayv mippene chayya veop — lo yispoq kap el kap velo yetappeach kappayv al yereko velo yeraqqed beraglayv kede lehabricham kederek shehu oseh bechol, gezera shemma yittol tzeror veyizroq lahem lirshut harabbim kede lehabricham. Veakshav sheyyesh omerim sheen lanu reshut harabbim gemura — epshar sheyyesh lehaqel bezeh, sheen gozerim gezera ligzera, kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"b:

En sochaqin beegozim velo betappuchim vekayyotze bahem al gabbe qarqa, gezera shemma yabou lehashvot gumot shebbaqqarqa bemtekkavven lehakin derek legalgel haegoz o hattappuach. Abal muttar lischoq al gabbe hashshulchan o al gabbe machatzelet, abal lo al gabbe qarqa apillu hamrutztzap, kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"z gabbe sikat qarqa. Umuttar lischoq baatzamot (sheqqorin tashey"ke) ap al pi shemmashmia qol, hoil veenan mitkavvenim leshir. Vekol zeh besocheq derek tzechoq bealma, abal besocheq kede leharviach — asur, apillu besocheq betam vechaser (sheqqorin gra"d o av"m gra"d), mippene sheddomeh lemiqqach umimkar. Umikkol maqom, en limchot benashim uqetannim apillu sochaqin beegozim al gabbe qarqa, lepi shebbevadday lo yishmeu, umutab sheyyihyu shogegim veal yihyu mezidim. Velischoq bekaddur — nitbaer besimman sh"ch:

Asur lishob mayim begalgal, shemmittok shemmemalle bo belo torach — yesh lachush shemma yemalle bo leginnato ulechurbato, o lemishra shel pishtan. Lepikak, im en sham besamuk lo ginna velo churba, velo bereka lishrot bah pishtan — muttar. Veap al pi shehaggalgal mashmia qol — eno qol shel shir. Veyesh omerim shello aseru ella begalgal gadol shemmotzi mayim harbeh beyachad belo torach, vehem galgallim haqqebuim bahem delayim harbeh sabib, abal begalgallim shellanu sheen memalleim bahem ella meat — muttar ap im yesh sham ginna o churba o bereka besamuk lo. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel bedibre soperim:

Mi sheyyesh lo perot berosh haggag veroeh matar shebba — asur leshalshelam beshabbat derek arubba shebbaggag, mippene shettoreach bedabar sheeno letzorek shabbat, umaaseh chol hu vezilzul leshabbat, ap al pi shebbeyom tob muttar, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqk"a. Abal muttar lekassotan mippene hammatar. Vaapillu lebenim hassedurim lebinyan shehem muqtzim — muttar lekassotan bipne haddelep bekelim hammuttarim betiltul, shehakkeli nittal letzorek dabar sheeno nittal, kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"z:

Muttar litten keli tachat haddelep beshabbat, veim nitmalle — shopeko umachaziro limqomo. Vehu sheyyehe haddelep rauy lirchitza al kol panim, abal im eno rauy liklum vahare hu muqtzeh veasur betiltul — asur litten keli tachtayv, mippene shemmebattelo mehekano. Veim abar unetano — muttar letaltelo bamayim hammeusim shebbo kede lehotzio mishsham, im hu omed bemaqom sheyyeshibato qebua sham, mippene shehu kigrap shel rei shehittiru letaltelo lehotzio laashpa mippene kebodo, im hu bemaqom sheyyeshibato qebua sham, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"ch. Veap al pi ken asur litteno sham lekattechilla al semak shellibsop yotziennu veyishpekennu velo yebattelennu mehekano, lepi shello hittiru bigrap shel rei ella bediabad, abal lekattechilla asur laasot gerap shel rei ella bimqom hepsed, kemo shennitbaer sham:
